family_reports.body: Destroyed. Children still in foster care. Kinship ignored. Creating trauma for CHILDREN, emotional regulation, safety, grossly over medicating, stability, separation, splitting full siblings apart without visitation. Good case workers who put the children first would vanish after a month or two. All for federal block grants and funding. The children's best interest was not considered. 3 judges and five lawyers in 5 years, numerous case workers. I'm fighting to make it until my babies reach 18. Systemic abuse has been deep and total.

Two years without your children is a lot of time. Missing teeth and first days. It’s not just hard on us. They’re home now, But we’re all so, so very mentally and emotionally fucked, each in our own ways, and I’m scared we won’t ever be the same.
